sectionNotes.parking: Net floor area is gross floor area less air shafts, elevator shafts, stairwells, mechanical rooms, electrical and telephone rooms, and storage rooms. Retail and restaurant ratios do not apply to facilities inside a hotel, and a hotel needs no spaces for malls, atriums, patios, lobbies, circulation areas, incidental retail, bars or restaurants.

notes: Structures below ground, steps, walks, driveways, parking areas, curbing, planters, walls, fences and hedges up to 4 ft high, landscaping, guardhouses and exterior lighting are exempt from the setbacks.
All building sides must be faced with face brick, stone, concrete, aluminum, glass or similar quality face materials.
Wood frame construction of exterior walls is prohibited.
All public and private utilities must be underground.
Refuse containers must be screened from public streets by a solid fence or wall at least 6 ft high.
Landscaping is required on every site within 180 days of first occupancy or completion of the buildings, with automatic underground sprinklers for landscaped areas.

history.080-601: Rezoned 11.02 acres from Commercial to a PD for hotel, office and retail
history.008-005: Changed the height limit to 790 ft above sea level and revised hotel parking
